# Instructions for AI coding agents (Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, etc.)

The single source of truth is **[CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md)**. Read it fully, then `docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` and `docs/APP_SPEC.md`.
Run `npm run verify` before finishing. Do not modify `src/layout/*`, `src/ui/*`, `src/index.css` or `tailwind.config.js`.
